reviews.title: Estafadores
reviews.text: My flight was cancelled, and I'm still waiting for a refund. They do not respond to any email, I think they have scammed me. I will not fly with them again.
reviews.author: Xavier

reviews.title: AVOID!!!!!
reviews.text: 1st, there was a problem with the website, it kept writing error although the money was taken from my bank account. 2nd, they sent me to the wrong airport!!! 500 km away! 3rd, they cancelled my return flight. 4th, they became silent when I asked for the reimbursement. HIGHLY UNPROFESSIONAL!
reviews.author: Jeanne

reviews.title: Worst Airlines
reviews.text: Flight got cancelled and was supposed to get a full refund, after receiving an e-mail saying that the refund is confirmed and should arrive back in my bank account it has not been credited even after a month. Choose a different airline
reviews.author: Pranav

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I just received an email about a flight schedule change and was offered a very unattractive change. Got information, that I can refuse and select another flight with one of three channels: 1) email, 2) FB messenger, 3) call centre... what followed: 1) email returned a postmaster delivery error and informed that the recipients of the email given by Nok Air were not found... 2) at FB my message was read, but nobody bother to respond... 3) nobody answers my call at the call centre Dear Nok Air, what quality of service it is? You change my flight to a much worse one, say that I can require a different one, but then don't answer at ANY OF THE CHANNELS that you provided... And, of course, it is the last-second change (the flight is tomorrow) and you say, that my appeal can only be made a day ahead... do you want to just wait me out? Can anyone answer??
reviews.author: Maciej P

reviews.title: Low Cost Airlines with Premium Price on many routes
reviews.text: Since 2020, I have love and hate affairs with Nok Air on regular basis. As my job demand me to fly to many locations such as Buriram, Chiangmai, Chiangrai, Chumphon, Hatyai, Lampang, Loei, Mae Sot, Nakhon Sri Thammarat, Ranong, Surat Thani, Phuket, Udon Thani, and Ubon Ratchatani. So, I ended up flew Nok Air more than another available airlines in Thailand domestic sercies. The positive side, Nok Air tends to have one of the best coverage throughout Thai airports. If you have to travel to certain provinces, Nok Air is one of the airline that came out of your mind that they will fly there. Especially remote provinces. Average side: Seat comfort is better than many low cost airline. Larger seat. But old and not very well maintained. Average leg room, better than some low cost airlines. No entertainment in the same manner with other airlines. So-so customer services. Apart from lucky draw for customers to fill in during 2021, nothing fancy came up to my mind. On highly competitive flights, they are value for money. Their plane is probably the cleanest among low cost carriers. Prior to covid19, they tend to have some hot food as a complimentary. Now I did not see them until today. Negative side of this airline: Check in and boarding services are as bad as any low cost airlines. But the worst part is the lack of concern over the passengers who have to depart but may stuck with some of the airport security. I have to admit that Don Muang Airport is one of the worst airport in secur
reviews.author: Chakrit T

reviews.title: The worst in a world
reviews.text: The shitest compagny ever. Never take a ticket with that compagny It’s a scam stole the money for foreigners tourist
reviews.author: Sid M

reviews.title: FLIGHT Cancellation & refund...
reviews.text: This flight was cancelled by Nok Air on December 3rd 2022. I opted for a full refund & was advised that the process had begun Dec 6th & would take 45 business days to appear back in my account. Today March 15th I have it back after multiple times contacting Nok Air & my Thai bank SCB. Nok Air excuse was that they had paid it but it had not gone through. I personally think that they use so many excuses hoping that finally you give up, I do not give up.So if the owe you please persist.....if you paid by card you have a better chance. Disgraceful management unfortunately because on another flight I had to commend the staff lol..
reviews.author: lesallen45

reviews.title: 1200 baht for bagage
reviews.text: Yeah the ground crew was nice, but paying 1200 baht for your bagage (15kg) while I tried to log in before hand is crazy. Keep your money and don’t fly with NOK.
reviews.author: Jesse B

reviews.title: Cancelled flight, after three months no refund and no replies
reviews.text: I've flown with this airline in the past and had a good experience. However, in November about a week after I booked a flight, I was told it was cancelled. They said it would take around 45 business days to receive a refund. Why that long, I have no idea. On top of that, it's been well over 45 business days and I still haven't received the refund. I've sent at least five emails asking them about the situation and they have not replied. No idea what is going on there, but I'm not sure how long they can continue to operate like that.
reviews.author: DanMc577

reviews.title: Worst airline ever !!!!!!!
reviews.text: I had a flight booked along with hotels at my destination. They cancelled my flight and offered a refund. To this day I have not received any refund or apology. I lost a week of my holiday. DO Not FLY with this airline.
reviews.author: Kieron K

reviews.title: Wheel chair assistance..superb service
reviews.text: I published a review a few days ago on how badly we were treated by Air Asia regarding the need for a wheel chair for my wife. Now I wish to publish a review for NOK AIR on how good they were in this particular instance. This was our first ever flight with NOK AIR. On check in the young lady already was aware that we needed the wheel chair, she also moved us from row 6 to row 4 closer to the boarding door cabin staff were on the ball both ways. On arrival Bangkok a wheel chair was ready with a Nok Air guy to assist, he took us all the way from the Aircraft to Air Asia check in for our next flight. Then our problems began with Air Asia. Assistance with Nok Air was second to none both ways. Thank you
reviews.author: lesallen45

reviews.title: No frills, a lot of character!
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my experience with Nok, from flight booking to the flight itself. The flight departed on time from Bangkok Don Mueang and arrived ahead of schedules at Hat Yai. In flight experience is of course basic, but the plane was clean and the cabin crew polite and attentive. Announcements were in English also, which we found reassuring and definitely helpful (at least for us). Would definitely use these guys again for future SE Asia trips!
reviews.author: nk761

reviews.title: Please don't flight with NOK
reviews.text: We were traveling around Thailand and we have two flights with NOK and both were delayed first one they change time and even with later time scheduled they delay second one they didn't even have plane so we are waiting 3 more hours.
reviews.author: Natália B

reviews.title: Do not buy the premium tickets. Pointless!
reviews.text: No priority check in, no lounge, nothing basically in Phuket. Might have well just got the cheapest tickets. What a scam.
reviews.author: tweetyduck

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: DO NOT BOOK THIS AIRLINES!! They always delayed schedules because they want to fill up their planes and don't care of other people schedules... If you have transfer flights good luck...
reviews.author: Nicolas Reynard

reviews.title: Cheap but very poor service
reviews.text: I flew Nok air from Saigon to BKK and then on to Chiang Mai. The first flight was fine but when you arrive in BKK you cannot use the quick transfer lane for domestic flights, so you need to go out of the international terminal and then through domestic check in. This takes quite a long time and the layover time was only 1.5 hours so almost missed the flight. Then at check in I asked if I was ok to take my carry on luggage on the plane. It was 1kg over the weight limit so then followed a very confusing exchange where the check in staff told me to just take it but then changed and asked to to check it but then changed again when they opened the bag and saw lots of electronics in it. Anyway, got the next flight in the end and it was fine. Basically with Nok you get what you pay for.
reviews.author: Andrew S
reviews.route: Ho Chi Minh City - Chiang Mai

reviews.title: Don’t fly with Nok air!
reviews.text: We came to Thailand and surrounding countries for Christmas 2022 we had 3 flights with Nok air and they cancelled then 6 times and changed then to times we had to spend 8 hours waiting for one and then we booked priority tickets due to our luggage weight limits. Get to the final flight and they have us only for priority boarding!!!!! All tickets booked at the same time with the same requirements yet this final insult is why I will never fly with this airline again. Too stressful for such small flights and time onboard made into a nightmare of cancelled tickets and time changes!!!
reviews.author: wintonperry

reviews.title: Worst ticket aftersale service ever
reviews.text: Worst ticket aftersale service ever It could not be true that nokair can cancel flights and after my reply they changed the flight to a false date. I got no flight and no money and they don't wantet to do anything.
reviews.author: Rudi L

reviews.title: Worst airlines
reviews.text: Worst airline i have ever seen very rude behaviour of staff… i was on time they took so much time on check in counter i told her i have a flight still she doesn’t understand i dnt know what she is checking in her desktop and then before time they close the door of plane not even announced my name and then she said I thought u are not coming so we close the doors now doors cannot be open. I told her you guys closed the door before time then she said yes we thought you are not coming staff was not at all helpful and very rude. My time and money wasted 😡😡😡 they are not even listening
reviews.author: Jeny

reviews.title: Used several times and have always been happy with the service.
reviews.text: Nok is a fairly good low cost airline that deserves a higher review than many have given it, it a no frills regional that works well and has had a good fleet of fairly new 737-800 with some great paint jobs too. I have about 5 flights of experience and they have always been good, recommended.
reviews.author: Damian D

reviews.title: It is better to book other airlines
reviews.text: I booked a flight from Udon Thani to Chiang Mai. The airplane was in the air 15 minutes and then returned back because of technical issue. Then we waited in the airport until the technical issue was fixed. The airplane was old. The service is less good than other airlines in Thailand.
reviews.author: Leon G

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: Flights are delayed constantly. Tried to explain that I would miss my flight if I still had to pickup the bag (8.5kg) but nope. Bi**es didn't understand. Lost the the connection because the flight was delayed and still went to pickup the bag. Won't go again
reviews.author: Tiago P

reviews.title: Unhelpful staff
reviews.text: So you cannot fly with powerbanks, in case nor hand luggage. Got my brand new one taken off me without a single thing I can do. Top tip, keep it in your case or you will loose it.
reviews.author: Michael G

reviews.title: NOK Air One of the worst low price carries in the region!! Flying DD851 SGN DKM 18.11.22
reviews.text: 1hour delay given one day in advance! Check in very bad, supervisor at check-in very rude, and I ended up paying as much as the ticket because she insisted to check in my carry on luggage ! 1kg over allowance she say.. Anyway, no one else seems to follow same rules. I flying Air Asia many times with no hustle at all ! Now at hate and further delay with no info what so ever… This is 2022, and we are out of pandemic, but it seems this airline not woke up yet !!! Not recommend !!! Choose a full service carrier like Vietnam Airline and better service for same price or even cheaper when you are forced to check in luggage at airport!
reviews.author: Salmon

reviews.title: Ja
reviews.text: Terrible aircraft condition, cancelled flight, late bording. I do not recommend to choose this company
reviews.author: axol a

reviews.title: NOT WORTH THE PRICE..... AVOID THIS AIRLINE
reviews.text: We flew from BKK to CNX on Nok air in their "premium" cabih. Nothing about it was premium. The aircraft was filthy, there was no extrra leg room (which we paid for). The middle seat was occupiied (their premium sercice promotes the middle seat vacant). We weren't offered so much as a glass of water and the flight attendants were the rudest I've ever encountered (and I've flownt to 42 countries so far).
reviews.author: CanadianFlashPacker

reviews.title: Cheerful colours  of crew and planes not matched by staff
reviews.text: The cheerful canary yellow uniforms of the flight crew are matched by the livery of their aircraft - If only the happiness went into their attitude as well. Yes, they are a low-cost carrier, and I am sure the crew doesn’t have the same work environment as the crews of higher-end airlines – but that is no justification for a bad attitude. Everything about the flight was – low cost. They have so much potential. - at least they had a Skybridge at DMK and HKT
reviews.author: Thomas@TomVoyage

reviews.title: Nok air does not accept their voucher
reviews.text: I had booked a trip with Nok Air during the pandemic. Nok air cancelled their flight and gave me a voucher. When I tried to book a trip for 2 , this month, I used my voucher but Nok Air refused my payment for the balance. I was in touch with their customer service department, they refuse to give me back my voucher and to accept my payment. It sounds terrible bit it is! They refuse your payment for you to loose your voucher. I will never fly Nok air in the future. A terrible airline who do not care for their customers.
reviews.author: Luc R

reviews.title: Burglars
reviews.text: They deceive everyone advertising the additional luggage fee is affordable before purchasing, but there is no option to buy it during checkout. You have no resort but to buy it at the airpot check-in. They charge enormous amount of money for little luggage. It is much cheaper to buy another company's ticket and they will never respond to your inquiry by email.
reviews.author: Tripa132

reviews.title: Don’t use it!
reviews.text: Bad service and very unclear about everything. Most of the people can’t even speak English. Total Joke. We’ve used Bangkok airways for other flights and it’s 100x better and we found about the same price. AVOID!!
reviews.author: Pit
